hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); l=love; [ -x "$r/out/love" ] && l="$r/out/love"; ("$l" bee --state busy --pid $PPID --hud </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0
r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); l=love; [ -x "$r/out/love" ] && l="$r/out/love"; ("$l" bee --state idle --pid $PPID --hud </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0
